about.title: Engineering software that lasts
about.intro: I'm a Senior Full-Stack .NET developer who builds enterprise applications meant to survive growth, not just launch. I own the whole path, from SQL Server schema to Angular UI to Azure deployment, using Clean Architecture, DDD and CQRS so codebases stay readable and testable as teams and requirements change. I work in Italian, English and Arabic, and I've delivered for clients in Italy, the UAE and the USA.

pillars.p1Desc: Clean Architecture, DDD and CQRS give every system clear boundaries and testable layers, so it stays maintainable as it grows.
pillars.p2Desc: From SQL Server schemas and .NET APIs to Angular frontends and Flutter mobile apps, I deliver the whole stack in one consistent language.
pillars.p3Desc: Dockerized services, CI/CD on Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, 70%+ unit test coverage and SonarQube checks, so performance and reliability are built in from the start.

featured.title: Audio Store: Enterprise E-Commerce Platform
featured.description: A production-ready e-commerce platform built end-to-end during my internship at Exprivia: a customer storefront plus an admin panel for sales analytics, order tracking and promo codes. Built on 4-layer Clean Architecture with DDD, 50+ JWT-secured REST endpoints and an Angular SPA with NgRx and 8 lazy-loaded modules.
